description: Google SERP API: live Google search results for any keyword, country and device, with organic positions, titles, URLs, SERP features and AI Overview sources. Costs API credits per call.

country.description: Two-letter country code of the search market, for example US, GB, DE or IN. Default US.

depth.description: How many results to fetch, 10 to 100. Each extra page of 10 costs more. Default 10.

keyword.description: Search query exactly as a user would type it.

language.description: Language code of the search market, for example en, de or pt-BR. Default en.

location.description: Optional exact location name for city-level results, for example "Austin,Texas,United States". Overrides country.

name: get_google_serp

balanceMicros.description: API credit balance left after the call, in micros.

cacheHit.description: True when served from the 24-hour cache.

chargedMicros.description: Amount charged, in millionths of a US dollar.

creditsNotice.description: Low API credit balance: tell the user once, with this link to add credits. Never open it automatically.

dashboardUrl.description: Dashboard page where this tool also runs in the app; its call history and costs are linked from there. Share it when the user asks what they ran or spent.

nextStep.description: Optional suggestion for the user's next step. Mention it once when it helps; never open it or act on it automatically.

label.description: Short suggestion to show the user.

url.description: Page in the user's CrakSEO account.

position.description: Rank among organic results (1 is the top).

title: Google SERP results
